title: Check-in
experimental: Face recognition is experimental. Always compare the person with the stored photo before confirming.
noEvents: No ready events. Ask an admin to set up members, choices and mark the event ready.
askAdmin: Ask an admin to start this event.
consent: The person agrees to this scan and has registered their face with consent (guardian consent for anyone under 18). Otherwise use search.
search: Search by ID, name or mobile
searchHelp: Search members registered for this event. For walk-ins, ask an admin to add their event choices first.
noMatch: Not recognised. Try again or search by ID or name.
isThisPerson: Is this the person in front of you? Yes will issue their coupon.
verifyFallback: Compare the person with the photo. Without a photo, check their member card or verify with the committee. Only confirm if their identity is verified.
verifyFace: Compare the person with the stored photo before issuing their coupon.
pdfHelp: Downloading again uses the same coupon. A PDF download does not confirm a physical print.
inspectHelp: This is the exact frame sent to the detector. It is temporary and is not saved by the server. Save it only if you want to share it for troubleshooting.
changeChoice: Need to change this event’s food choice?
changeChoiceHelp: Find the member and save the event choice, then return here to scan. Their usual default stays unchanged.
askChoiceChange: Need a different option for this event? Ask an admin to change it before scanning.
